name: double-escape-over-a-draft
opens_with: (esc esc over a typed draft opens the selector)
notes: 2026-10-31: THE live-reported defect. The arm required prompt_input.is_empty(), so Esc Esc over a half-written draft opened nothing — the selector is 'go back a turn', and the operator who needs it is holding text they are about to abandon anyway. The fix parks the draft (App::rewind_draft_held) for the selector's lifetime and hands it back on every exit. This golden pins the OPEN: the draft is staged in the composer, the two Ecs land inside the 500 ms window, and the selector renders. The unit test double_escape_over_a_draft_opens_the_selector_and_cancel_restores_it pins the park and the restore; this scenario pins the gesture surviving the real key handler and the real render path. Divergence from oh-my-pi noted there: omp requires the empty editor (input-controller.ts:628-630) and parks nothing.
